reservations.note: Celestial Park. Book online or call 407-224-3663 for a party of 7.
Lost Continent. Top-rated table service; closes for good in 2027.

days.label: Wed
days.title: Arrival night
days.summary: Check in at Cabana Bay. If there's energy left, CityWalk is a 15–25 minute walk.

steps.title: Set up phones
steps.detail: Open this app on every phone and add it to the Home Screen. Link tickets and Express in the Universal app (there are no ticket kiosks at the gates any more).

steps.title: Optional: CityWalk dinner
steps.detail: Antojitos (tableside guacamole), Bigfire (DIY s'mores) or Toothsome (over-the-top shakes). The Universal Studios Store at CityWalk has a Butterbeer bar.

steps.title: Early night
steps.detail: Tomorrow's Epic shuttle leaves around 7:45am.

days.label: Thu
days.title: Epic Universe, full day
days.summary: First look at everything. Early entry 9am, park 10am–8pm, fireworks at close. Express covers everything except Dragon Racer's Rally.

steps.title: Shuttle to Epic Universe
steps.detail: Cabana Bay has its own Epic shuttle (15–25 min). Buses start about 2 hours before opening. Guests are let in about 15 minutes before early entry.

steps.title: Early entry: Super Nintendo World
steps.detail: Mine-Cart Madness first (its line peaks around 2½ hours), then Mario Kart. Buy Power-Up Bands ($45 each) at the 1-UP Factory. If Nintendo isn't in early entry today, start at Stardust Racers and the Ministry instead; the Now tab shows what's open.

steps.title: Nintendo, the rest of it
steps.detail: Yoshi's Adventure, the key challenges (3 keys unlock Bowser Jr. Shadow Showdown), Mario & Luigi, Peach, Toad and Donkey Kong meets. Snack: the DK Crush Float at The Bubbly Barrel is the closest thing to a Dole Whip float.

steps.title: Isle of Berk
steps.detail: Hiccup's Wing Gliders on Express, the Toothless meet (walk-up; lines grow through the day), Fyre Drill and Viking Training Camp. Dragon Racer's Rally has no Express, so only ride it if the standby line is short. Lunch at Mead Hall.

steps.title: The Untrainable Dragon
steps.detail: About 20 minutes. Sit mid-theater. Check the Explore tab for today's times.

steps.title: Ministry of Magic
steps.detail: Battle at the Ministry on Express, Le Cirque Arcanus, and the 12 wand spell spots. Save the big Butterbeer stop for Saturday's lunch.

steps.title: Dark Universe
steps.detail: Curse of the Werewolf first. Monsters Unchained is the scariest ride in the resort for an 8-year-old; preview the queue and decide. The windmill bursts into flames about every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Dinner at Atlantic
steps.detail: Reservation. Kids' menu comes in a beach pail.

steps.title: Stardust Racers and re-rides
steps.detail: Stardust Racers on Express, Constellation Carousel, then anything the Now tab says is short.

steps.title: Universal Celestial Goodnight
steps.detail: Fountains, lights and fireworks at close. Best views around the Cosmos Fountain.

days.label: Fri
days.title: Islands, Studios, then Islands again
days.summary: Early entry at Islands at 8am for Hagrid's, Hogwarts Express to Studios at midday, back to Islands for dinner. Studios closes at 5pm for Horror Nights.

steps.title: Walk to Islands of Adventure
steps.detail: Walking path from Cabana Bay to CityWalk is 15–25 min, then about 2 min to the Islands gate. The shuttle to CityWalk runs every ~15 min.

steps.title: Early entry: Hagrid's first
steps.detail: Hagrid's has no Express, so this is the moment. Then VelociCoaster and Forbidden Journey while lines are short. Anyone sitting one out does Flight of the Hippogriff and Ollivanders; use Rider Switch so the second adult doesn't line up again.

steps.title: Jurassic Park
steps.detail: Pteranodon Flyers (no Express; riders 36–56" so all three kids qualify), Camp Jurassic, the Raptor Encounter, and the Discovery Center egg hatching around half past the hour. River Adventure is closed for refurbishment.

steps.title: Marvel Super Hero Island
steps.detail: Spider-Man on Express. Hulk needs 54" and Doctor Doom 52": the youngest does Storm Force Accelatron or the Marvel meet while the others ride.

steps.title: Hogwarts Express to King's Cross
steps.detail: From Hogsmeade Station. The show is different in each direction.

steps.title: Leaky Cauldron lunch
steps.detail: Butterbeer hot, cold and frozen, plus the Butterbeer potted cream. Mobile order may be available; check the Universal app.

steps.title: Diagon Alley
steps.detail: Gringotts on Express, the Ollivanders wand show, Knockturn Alley, Celestina Warbeck or Beedle the Bard. Watch for the dragon breathing fire every 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Minions, Simpsons, Men in Black
steps.detail: Minion Mayhem and Villain-Con Minion Blast (sign in to the Universal app before the moving walkway so scores sync), the Simpsons Ride, Men in Black.

steps.title: Studios closes; walk to Islands
steps.detail: About 10 minutes through CityWalk.

steps.title: Dinner at Mythos
steps.detail: Reservation. Lagoon and Hulk views.

steps.title: Seuss Landing and evening re-rides
steps.detail: Cat in the Hat, One Fish Two Fish, Caro-Seuss-el and the Trolley. Express was used once per ride today, so check the Now tab for short standby lines.

steps.title: Dark Arts at Hogwarts Castle
steps.detail: Projection show on the castle from dusk, on select nights. Best view in front of the Frog Choir stage or from the Jurassic Park bridge.

days.label: Sat
days.title: Epic round two, then Studios
days.summary: Epic's earliest opening (early entry 8am, park 9am) with fresh Express rides, then Studios until 5pm. Early night before the cruise.

steps.title: Shuttle to Epic Universe
steps.detail: Early entry starts at 8am today.

steps.title: Early entry: favorites again
steps.detail: Express resets today, so every Express ride is fresh. Start with whatever the kids loved most on Thursday, or whatever you missed.

steps.title: Fill the gaps
steps.detail: Use the Now tab: anything not done yet, short standby lines, unused Express rides. The Untrainable Dragon starts earlier on days the park opens at 9am.

steps.title: Butterbeer lunch at Café L'air de la Sirène
steps.detail: No reservation. The Bièraubeurre crêpe and hot, cold and frozen Butterbeer in one sitting. Then the Butterbeer macaron at K. Rammelle, sold nowhere else.

steps.title: Bus to Studios
steps.detail: Epic is on its own bus line: budget 45–60 minutes door to door.

steps.title: DreamWorks Land, Transformers, the Mummy
steps.detail: Trolls Trollercoaster and Po's Kung Fu Training Camp, Transformers, E.T. The Mummy is intense and dark; the youngest can do Race Through New York next door instead.

steps.title: Animal Actors or Bourne Stuntacular
steps.detail: Animal Actors ends for good on Nov 2. Its last show is around 4pm.

steps.title: Studios closes; easy dinner
steps.detail: CityWalk on the way back, or Islands for a last round until 8pm if everyone still has energy. Pack for the cruise tonight.
